title: Who paid for the $11 million spent against Graham Platner?
description: Tall infographic of the funding pipeline, from the PAC’s own FEC donor ledger. Left: money whose original source is hidden — Stronger America, Inc. ($3,000,000, a 501(c)(4) whose own funders have no filing) and Lexington Fund ($1,000,000, funders undisclosed). Right: ten named donors with amounts and dates (press-reported entries flagged). Both flow into Pine Tree Results PAC (raised $16,099,657), then to sole vendor SRCP Media ($10,723,548), ending with the six FEC Form 24 receipts, each declaring OPPOSE: PLATNER, GRAHAM. Notes that the full interactive version with every receipt is at the site.
alt_text: Tall dark infographic titled “Who paid for the $11 million spent against Graham Platner?” Two columns: “Money whose original source is hidden” shows Stronger America, Inc. giving $3,000,000 with the note “Who funded it? No filing exists,” and Lexington Fund giving $1,000,000 with funders undisclosed. “Money with a name attached” lists ten donors from Kenneth Griffin at $2.5 million down to Alex Karp at $100,000. Arrows converge on a red box, Pine Tree Results PAC, raised $16,099,657, which points to SRCP Media, paid $10,723,548. Below are six receipt cards, each stamped OPPOSE: PLATNER, GRAHAM, totaling the six ad buys. Footer points to the full interactive ledger site.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
